1.text: Maze Yobu akomeza guca imigani ye ati

2.text: “Ndarahira Imana ihoraho,Ari yo yanyimye ibyari binkwiriye,N'Ishoborabyose yababazaga ubugingo bwanjye.

3.text: Ubugingo bwanjye buracyari buzima,Kandi Umwuka w'Imana ni we utuma mpumeka.

4.text: Ni ukuri iminwa yanjye ntizavuga ibyo gukiranirwa,N'ururimi rwanjye na rwo ntiruzariganya.

5.text: Ntibikabeho yuko nabemerera ngo muvuze ibitunganye,Kugeza ubwo nzapfa sinzikuraho kuba inyangamugayo.

6.text: “Gukiranuka kwanjye ndagukomeje ntabwo nzakurekura,Ntabwo umutima wanjye uzagira icyo unshinja nkiriho.

8.text: Noneho utubaha Imana agira byiringiro ki,Iyo Imana imuciye ikamwaka ubugingo bwe?

9.text: Mbese Imana yakumva gutaka kwe,Ibyago nibimutera?

10.text: Cyangwa se yakwishimira Ishoborabyose,Akajya atabaza Imana ibihe byose?

12.text: Dore mwese mwarabyirebeye,None se ni iki gitumye muba ab'ubusa gusa?

13.text: “Uwo ni wo mugabane umunyabyaha abikiwe n'Imana,N'ibizaba ku barenganya bagenewe n'Ishoborabyose.

14.text: Abana be nibororoka bazaba abo kugabizwa inkota,Kandi urubyaro rwe ntiruzahazwa n'ibyokurya.

15.text: Abe basigaye bazamirwa n'urupfu,Kandi abapfakazi be ntibazabaririra.

16.text: Nubwo arundanya ifeza nk'umukungugu,Akirundaniriza imyambaro nk'urwondo,

17.text: Abasha kuyirundanya ariko izambarwa n'umukiranutsi,Na ya mafeza azagabanwa n'abatariho urubanza.

18.text: Yiyubakira inzu imeze nk'iy'inyenzi,Nk'akararo kubatswe n'umurinzi.

19.text: Yiryamira ari umukungu akabyuka ari nta cyo akigira,Arambuye amaso asanga byose byagiye.

20.text: Ibiteye ubwoba bimwisukaho nk'isuri,N'umugaru umujyana ari nijoro.

21.text: Umuyaga w'iburasirazuba uramutwara akagendanirako,Uramuhitana akava aho yari ari.

22.text: Ndetse Imana iramusumira ntimubabarire,Nubwo yifuza guhunga amaboko yayo.

23.text: Abantu bazamwirukana bamucyamuye,Bamwimyoze ngo ave iwe.
